value.name: Jesse Ebenezer
value.biography:
Jesse Ebenezer is a proud alumnus of Clifford University and one of the university’s pioneering Alpha Students, having commenced his academic journey with the institution on March 5, 2017. He was also part of the Alpha Graduating Set, making him part of the historic foundation upon which the university has continued to build its legacy.

Jesse studied Microbiology at Clifford University, where he developed not only academically but also a strong passion for leadership, service, and institutional development. Throughout his years of association with the university, he became known for his commitment to progress, his willingness to contribute meaningfully, and his reputation for taking purposeful actions toward the development of his community.

Beyond academia, Jesse has built a career in real estate, specializing in areas including property acquisition, investment, and real estate transactions. His professionalism, dedication, and ability to build lasting relationships have earned him recognition and trust from international clients and real estate brands, allowing him to work across diverse markets and with professionals from different parts of the world.

Jesse is married to Maureen Nwaokeleme, a distinguished Clifford University alumna who served as the first Vice President of the Clifford University Students' Association (CLUSA) and later became the President of the association.

As a pioneer of Clifford University and a professional committed to continuous growth, Jesse remains passionate about leadership, development, service, and creating opportunities that leave a lasting impact.
